changes.comment: Say what the Codex runtime actually knows when it rejects an approval request. The warn log and the approval handler's module doc both explained the rejection in terms of Feishu outbound being MCP reply-only — a Channel fact a runtime package cannot see and does not depend on. Both now state the runtime-owned truth: approvals are unsupported in Dreamux-managed runtimes. Wording only; no behavior, config, state, or path shape changed and no rebuild is required.
